_readme: The Bridge sector: 400 x 400 m, centred on the origin, so x and y run -20000..+20000.
+Y is north (the world edge, where the extractions are), +X is east.
A ravine splits the sector east-west at y = 0 with exactly three crossings:
the pipe at x = -14000, the bridge at x = 0, the ford at x = +13000.
The near (north) half is quiet and poor; the far (south) half holds the best loot
and most of the bots, so the player must cross for the haul and cross back with it.
pos.z is the kind's own half-height, so every prop rests on the floor (top of floor = z 0).
'note' and '_readme' keys are ignored by the parser; they are here so the file reads as a plan.

blocks.note: RAVINE — north rim, y = +1800. Four segments with gaps at the pipe, the bridge and the ford. This line plus its southern twin is the map's spine; nothing else is a block.
RAVINE — south rim, y = -1800. Gaps aligned with the north rim, or a crossing would end in a wall.

RAVINE BED — the VISUAL stand-in for a 400-700 uu dig (spec §5.2), not a pit. Flat, non-colliding, 4 uu thick, sitting ON the floor: cliffs plus a dark bed plus water read identically from a top-down camera, and a real hole buys fall damage, stuck pawns and nav holes on iOS for zero gameplay. Crossability is still the eight rim walls above, exactly as before — nothing here digs, and nothing here stops anyone.

WATER — y = -700..+700 per ТЗ §5, on top of the bed (z 4..10). OPAQUE: a translucent material needs an authored asset and this project authors none (spec §5.2). Dark blue-grey on the darker bed reads as water from above; it will NOT read as water in a close-up, and the ford's 'мелкая вода' is this same tone rather than a lighter shallow. That is a shipped limitation, not a bug.

HIGHWAY (ТЗ §7). Authored under the traffic jam that already exists rather than on §7's (-1500,+20000) -> (0,0) line: the 28 wrecks, the checkpoint and the bridge approach rails were all placed on a straight x~0 centreline, and asphalt on the §7 diagonal would leave the whole jam standing in the grass — which is also what breaks the firing line (§7). So: straight from the bridge deck to y=+16500, then a westward bend toward the north edge. Roads are z 0..6, i.e. 2 uu above the ravine bed, so the two never z-fight where they meet. 1200 wide, inside §7's 900-1300.
The bend toward §7's north end. Stops at x=-600 rather than -1500 so the northernmost wrecks stay ON the asphalt.
South of the ravine the §7 line (0,0) -> (+1000,-10000) fits the existing content, so it is used verbatim: the wreck at (600,-9900) and the sandbags at y=-7200 sit on it.
The village/промзона fork at (+1000,-10000) — an east-west bar, kept north of the house at (1000,-11200) so no road runs under a building.

WEST DIRT ROAD (ТЗ §7): (-18000,+17000) -> (-15500,+11000) -> (-14500,+3000) -> pipes -> (-14500,-5000) -> АЗС. 650 wide (§7 wants 500-800) and LIGHTER than the ground (§14). This is Bridge_West's actual route, which is why it is the road that exists now; the east road, the village lanes and the ford's shallows are Stage C. Both pipe-crossing segments stop at the ravine bed's edge (y = +/-2200): the crossing itself is a walkway between pipes, not a road, and asphalt over the bed would z-fight a darker surface.
The spur along the АЗС's north face into its forecourt, so the station reads as somewhere a road goes rather than a shed in a field. Held clear of the building's north wall (y = -8250) on purpose.

buildings.note: S01 АЗС (ТЗ §28 / §9) at its ledger coordinate. Зал + подсобка + служебная, входы В и Ю exactly as ТЗ §9 names them: east is the forecourt the pump row stands on, south is the road onward to the ж/д тупик. Two exits, because a bot in the only doorway is a coffin (ТЗ §13); no door in the west face, which is the side the west dirt road runs past — a doorway there would let anyone on that road shoot straight through the building. Replaces the solid house prop that stood in for this shop 3800 uu further north.

interiorWalls.note: зал | подсобка. The opening sits well south of where the служебная wall below meets this one, so no interior wall ever ends inside another's doorway.

buildings.note: S04 D1 (ТЗ §28 / §9), проходим. A through-house at the west end of the village: north opens onto the village street and the run down from the bridge, which is where everyone arrives from; south opens onto the lane toward the scrap yard and the rail siding, which is where everyone is going. The two doorways are in different rooms on purpose — crossing the divider is the price of using the house as a shortcut. Replaces the westernmost solid village house.

S05 D2 (ТЗ §28 / §9), проходим, 2 good. One room, two exits — the simplest walkable shape, kept simple on purpose so the three buildings cover a range. North faces the street between the two village rows, east faces the lane to the highway fork; both are sides people actually walk past. Replaces the solid house prop 707 uu away whose footprint this building sits on.

props.note: THE BRIDGE — deck, three lanes (1800 uu of roadway) spanning the whole 3600 uu ravine and running 900 uu onto each bank. Sunk to a 40 uu lip so the pawn steps onto it instead of being stopped by it. Two lanes read as a footbridge from above; the main crossing has to be unmistakable.
THE BRIDGE — parapets. They make it read as a bridge from above and are the only cover you get while crossing.
THE BRIDGE — approach rails north and south. They funnel the run-up and, from above, are what turns a gap in the cliff into an obvious road crossing.

THE BRIDGE — four pylons, one at each corner of the two mouths. From the overview they mark the crossing; at the player's camera they are the only thing tall enough to say 'bridge' before you are on it, since the deck and the parapets are the same grey as the ground.
THE PIPE CROSSING (west) — a 420 uu walkway between two rows of standing pipes. Single file, and the pipes are tall enough to be a landmark from the north half.
THE FORD (east, x 12000..14000) has no props at all, on purpose: it is 2000 uu of open ground. Its cost is being seen.
THE HIGHWAY — a broken traffic jam from the north edge down to the bridge, in clusters of two or three with gaps: cover you can move along, with holes in it.
THE JUNCTION — the east-west road the highway comes off, so the jam reads as traffic and not as a fence.
SPAWN (north-west) — a broken fence with gaps, and junk to pick up. Nothing here is worth dying for, which is the point.
Moved 400 west and 500 south of where it was authored: ТЗ §8's spawn 03 at (-15000,+17000) stood inside this wreck's footprint. It is now L03's остов.
BUS STOP — a landmark on the way east, and the first real cover after spawn.
CHECKPOINT — two staggered sandbag lines north of the bridge, so the approach is a weave rather than a straight run. First military loot, first real decision.
RUINS (east edge, near half) — the only reason to go east before crossing, and the one bot in the near half lives here.

PETROL STATION FORECOURT (far half, west) — a pump row under a canopy. The shop that used to be the solid house here is now the walkable bridge_gas_station in "buildings", at the ТЗ §28 ledger coordinate 3800 uu south; the pumps stay where they were authored and remain the silhouette you navigate the south-west by.

VILLAGE — four solid houses in two staggered rows, plus the two walkable ones in "buildings" (D1 at the west end, D2 in the southern row). The 1600 uu gaps between them are the fighting lanes, and the stagger stops any lane running clean through the village.
Shifted 500 uu west of where it was authored: at x -2800 this fence overlapped bridge_village_d2's west wall by a 30 x 120 uu sliver.

Shifted 150 uu west of where it was authored: at x -2600 this crate was half-buried in bridge_village_d2's west wall. It now stands against the outside of it, which is where a crate by a house belongs.
RAIL SIDING (far half, south-west) — a stopped train. Long hard cover along one axis and nothing along the other, which makes approaching it a choice.
WATER TOWER — the landmark. 1400 uu tall, visible from the whole far half and from the bridge; it replaces the minimap.
INDUSTRIAL YARD (far corner) — best loot, most bots, and a sandbagged entrance so it cannot be walked into casually.

FARMSTEAD (near half, west) — the only landmark in the quiet north-west. Not in the spec's POI list: without it there is 200 m of featureless ground between the spawn and the pipe crossing and nothing to navigate by.
SCRAP YARD (far half, west-centre) — fills the ground between the village and the rail siding, and gives the pipe crossing somewhere to lead.
FARM COMPOUND (far half, east-centre) — between the water tower and the industrial yard, on the route back from the ford.
CEMENT WORKS (far half, west edge) — silos and two sheds. Fills 150 m of empty west bank and gives the pipe crossing somewhere to lead once you are across.
THE FIELD (far half, south of the village) — an old fight nobody cleared up. Broken cover in the open, so crossing the southern flats is not a free run.
SOUTHERN HOMESTEAD (far half, south-centre-east) — the last thing before the south edge, where the neighbouring sector will open.

containers.note: SPAWN CAMP (ТЗ §29 L01-L03) — the three junk containers. §29 has L13/L18/L25/L30 as junk too, but the owner's Bridge_West split is 3 junk, so junk is exactly the spawn camp: the first container the player ever opens teaches the interaction and holds nothing worth dying for.
L02 'дерево'. There is no tree kind and cannot be one (a canopy hides the player from a top-down camera), so this stands beside a treeline clump — see the flag list.
L03 'остов', shifted +100,+100 from §29's (-15100,+16600) so it stands 153 uu clear of the wreck's face rather than 53 — ТЗ §29 wants 120 uu free in front of a container.

THE PIPE CROSSING (L13, L18, L19). Re-tiered junk -> common per the owner's split. L19 (техдвор, south of the crossing) is where Task 5 puts the medkit: spec §6.5 teaches healing before the first bot, and the first bot is at the gas station.
THE GAS STATION (L20-L25). L20 is the зал, inside the walkable bridge_gas_station: a container you have to walk into a building for is the whole point of the building.
L21, подсобка — the west room, 285 uu clear of both interior walls.
L22, shifted +200 in y from §29's (-13000,-9800), which is 50 uu OUTSIDE the building's south wall. It is now at the south end of the зал.
L23, стойка, the sector's only med container. Shifted 50 west of §29's (-12500,-8400) so it stands 120 uu off the east wall's inner face rather than 70 — ТЗ §29 wants 80.
L24, фургон — beside the trailer Task 4 authors at (-15000,-7900).
L25, inside сарай S02 (Task 4). Re-tiered junk -> common.
THE RAIL DEPOT (L26-L30) — the deep end of the route, and the only place with military. L26 is the разгрузка pad, north of the warehouse.
L29, паллеты, inside the warehouse's east room (Task 4). Re-tiered common -> good.

MILITARY — no ledger row. ТЗ §29 puts no military west of the bridge (its four are the КПП and the промзона, all behind the closure), and the owner's Bridge_West split asks for two. They are here, at the deepest point of the route, and they retire when §29's four arrive with Stage D. This one is inside the warehouse's west room.
The second, beside the вагон at the depot's east end — the furthest point from E1, which is what makes carrying it home a decision.

playerSpawns.note: ТЗ §8's four, verbatim. One is chosen per raid. All four sit behind the broken fence at the north-west corner, facing south-east into the sector, and clear of every block — including Task 2's north and west world border, which starts at y = +19700 and x = -19700.

botSpawns.note: THE GAS STATION — two, per the owner's split. §11's АЗС парковка, verbatim.

§11's АЗС двор (-15000,-10500) shifted +400,-200 — the ledger point is exactly on сарай S02's east wall centre line, and a bot spawned inside a wall is the oldest bug on this map. §11 allows +/-300-800.
THE RAIL DEPOT — four, per the owner's split. These two are §11's ж/д запад and ж/д разгрузка, verbatim.

The two the owner's count adds beyond §11's west entries. Placed at the depot's own sub-areas and spaced so no two of the six can hear one shot: the closest pair on this map is rail_dock and rail_dispatcher at 2052 uu, against an 1800 uu hearing radius.

Shifted 400 south of the plan's (-12400,-15600): that point is INSIDE the freight car at (-12300,-15600), whose body is 1400 x 300 uu — a bot spawned inside a solid prop is the same bug the gas_yard note above is about, and no map test sees it because the invariants check blocks and building walls, not props. At y = -16000 it stands 250 uu clear of the car's south face, on the диспетчерская side of the train beside L28. §11 allows +/-300-800.

extractions.note: E1 (ТЗ §12), the pipes route, and the only extraction a Bridge_West player can reach. §12's trigger is ~1000x700; a 500 uu radius is the round equivalent. Task 2's north border leaves a 1200 uu mouth at exactly this x so E1 is the one gap in the treeline — the way out of the world.
extractions.name: Северная тропа

extractions.note: E2 (ТЗ §12), the main exit after the bridge. Behind the closure until Stage D; kept in data because §12 lists three and because Sarko.Extract.BridgeExtractionsAreReachableAndDistinct checks they never overlap.
extractions.name: Шоссе на север

extractions.note: E3 (ТЗ §12), after the ford. Behind the closure until Stage D.
extractions.name: Восточный кордон
